rules.statement: A sale under the Partition Act does not preserve life interests, usufructs, or other encumbrances declared in an interlocutory decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "it is clear that when, in pursuance of an order for the sale of a land, a certificate of sale of the land is entered in terms of section 46 of the Partition Act, the title which the certificate of sale confers on the purchaser of the land and buildings thereon is free from any life interest or usufruct which may be declared in favour of a person in the interlocutory decree entered under section 26, read with section 48, of the Act"

meta.parties: Cinemas Ltd. v. Ceylon Theatres Ltd
